title: 3D CNN identifies cervical spinal cord injury on CT
summary: A standardized 3D convolutional neural network on cervical spine CT regions of interest, built with data from two centers, identified cervical spinal cord injury with AUC-ROC of 0.943 (training), 0.953 (internal validation) and 0.948 (external validation). AUC-PR values were 0.936, 0.939 and 0.943. Cohort sizes were not visible in the abstract, regions of interest were manually delineated, and the study is retrospective.
ai_technology: Standardized 3D convolutional neural network (PyTorch) on manually delineated CT regions of interest

evidence.tested: Stratified training, internal validation and external validation sets from two independent centers.
evidence.unknown: Cohort sizes, prospective validation and clinical utility; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies CT regions as injured or non-injured spinal cord.

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
